summary: Set a CPC bid ceiling on the two Maximize Clicks campaigns. Neither campaign has any ceiling today, so nothing bounds the price of a click.

evidence.ceiling_today: none on either campaign (Paver Sealing, paused, carries $7.50)
evidence.note_on_the_30_dollar_click: The $30.06 term carried 2 conversion credits on ONE click. Those two credits are almost certainly the same form submission counted twice by (web) form_submission and WC Leads - the duplicate PLAN-SLM-CONV-1 addresses. Treated as one lead, not two.

risk: A ceiling lowers auction competitiveness. At $22 it binds Pavers (realised $22.76) and barely touches Patio (realised $13.98). If lost-impression-share-to-rank rises sharply without a rise in click volume, raise it back through a new plan.
rollback: Clear campaign.target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros on both campaigns through a new approved plan. No other object changes.
step_down_path: This is step 1. After PLAN-SLM-NEG-1 has 14 days of data, re-derive the ceiling from post-negative CPC and consider $18, then $16. Do not step down before that evidence exists.
validation: google-ads validate_only on the two campaign mutations
unchanged: budgets, bidding strategy type, networks, locations, keywords, negatives, ads, assets, conversion actions, the other four campaigns
